items.title: Oscar Rouzan Interview, 1972-12-12
items.q: he dug up my grandfather's mother with a Madame Roussain

ctx.x: He played something. Yeah, he had a nice style. It's part of, you know, old time, let's see, like, which style he played? Well, he copied, you know, a little bit of Armstrong and maybe a little bit of the other type of blues type of trumpet player. I wanted to ask you more about your teachers, too, and how they would teach. Well, teaching for that, if I go to style my brother, which was the first teacher, he was tone conscious. And I spent a lot of time in sudden tone, you know, building up. And he was a type of…

Yeah, that's just... Yeah, I dropped it a few times later. I was going to go see it. Your daughter's like Texas? One, the other one don't, but one, you know, I have one like Texas. I have an idea about... Yeah, well, first thing I could ask you is what your full name is. Yeah, Oscar, Jill and Rusevans. Just a second now. I'll let you go second on that because we were four Rusevans. At the time, we were four Oscar, Jill and Rusevans. Four generations of Rusevans. In fact, I got a picture somewhere around with the…
